visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a medium shot of an orange and white tabby cat standing on its hind legs, stretching its front paws high against a dark-framed glass door. The floor is made of dark, polished marble. (2) The camera follows the cat as it walks down a hallway with light-colored walls and dark tile flooring. The cat moves with curiosity, looking around the corner before heading towards another doorway. (3) A hand wearing a red sleeve enters the frame, inserting a key into a door lock and turning it. The door opens to reveal a bright indoor apartment with light-colored wooden floors. (4) The camera enters a spacious living room bathed in natural light from large floor-to-ceiling windows. An orange cat is seen perched on a cat tree near the window, silhouetted against the bright city skyline. (5) The cat jumps down from its perch and runs across the wooden floor towards the person entering. A young woman with short dark hair, wearing a striped navy and white sweater, bends down and picks up the cat, pulling it into a close, affectionate hug. (6) The woman continues to hold the cat near her face, smiling and closing her eyes as she cuddles it. The cat rests its head on her shoulder. (7) A close-up shot shows the cat's face as the woman holds it; the cat yawns widely while being cradled. (8) In the final phase, the cat stands on its hind legs to peer into an open blue suitcase lying on the floor, surrounded by various shopping bags and items. The cat then looks directly up at the camera with wide eyes.

(4) The young woman's voice becomes high-pitched and very excited, calling out a name twice with a rising intonation and high arousal. The BGM guitar and vocals swell slightly in volume. (5) As the reunion occurs, the young woman's voice is filled with joyful, warm inflections. A male voice enters in the background with a calm, conversational tone.
